plan.title: The Last Ship
plan.logline: A lighthouse keeper receives a message from a ship lost at sea and chooses to rescue its last survivor.
plan.ending: The keeper, driven by a desire to protect the last remaining survivor, embarks on a perilous journey to find the ship, navigating through treacherous waters and facing numerous challenges along the way. As they approach the ship, the keeper is confronted by its crew, who have been trapped for years. The keeper must decide whether to risk their own life to save the ship or risk their own safety to save the crew. In the end, the keeper chooses the latter, leading to a tragic but ultimately satisfying resolution.
